summary: Classify unavailable Linux namespace runtimes before the existing Task-029 sandbox probe while preserving hard failure for an actual launcher or emulator failure.

impacts.evidence: The preflight runs before the existing host-created sandbox session and adds no tenant, organization or workspace authority.
The preflight executes only an absolute system true command and does not inspect, persist or expose provider data or credentials.
No public API, SDK method or serialized result field changes; only the internal error classification before the existing probe changes.
The preflight publishes no event and does not alter any event envelope, catalog entry or outbox behavior.
Task-025 admission plans and Connector SDK v1 remain unchanged; ErrSandboxUnavailable is an existing host runtime error.
Namespace availability is evaluated transiently and introduces no database table, migration or stored state.

The preflight prevents a restricted kernel from being reported as a generic probe defect, while the real isolation probe still requires all existing namespaces, chroot, environment and network boundaries.
No operation policy, approval requirement, capability grant or production credential rule is changed.
The availability classification is transient test control flow and adds no audit, lineage or evidence payload.
The preflight cannot reach business state and does not alter retries, inbox, outbox, deduplication or reconciliation semantics.
The preflight verifies that the same network namespace required by the external isolation proof is available before the child is started; it grants no egress route.
Signed wall, CPU, RSS, output and concurrency limits remain enforced by the existing process monitor after preflight.
Restricted developer containers now receive an explicit runtime-unavailable qualification result, and reverting the code restores the prior generic failure without data migration.
The same test skips only when the kernel cannot create the required namespaces; namespace-enabled runtimes still execute and pass the real chroot isolation probe.
